brewing.notes: A safe starting point for green tea: cooler water, short steeps, then adjust by taste.

description:
A flat green tea from Gong County in Yibin, Sichuan, made from early-spring leaf grown in misty high-mountain gardens.

Treat it as you would any green tea: cooler water, short steeps, and a seller who can say where and when it was picked.
history: It was listed as a national speciality agricultural product for 2015 and took first prize at the second Guoyin Cup tea contest in 2012. Little more is documented.
processing: Traditional handwork combined with modern machinery.
appearance_dry: Flat and smooth, a dark ink-green.
taste_profile: High, lasting aroma and a fresh taste.
vintage_note: Green teas like this are normally sold as the current year's harvest and are best within a year of picking. It is not an ageing tea.
